lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgNb₂O₆ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 18 atoms (Mg₂Nb₄O₁₂) across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Nb in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Mg adopts a square-pyramidal environment of five O neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Nb octahedra, and between Mg square pyramids and Nb octahedra, with additional edge-sharing between Mg polyhedra; the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites.
